changeSet.sql:
IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ReferenceItem')) BEGIN DROP TABLE [dbo].[ReferenceItem] END
IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ReferenceItemType')) BEGIN DROP TABLE [dbo].[ReferenceItemType] END
changeSet.rollback:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ReferenceItemType')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ReferenceItemType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [DisplayFormat] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [SourceNotes] [nvarchar](max) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ReferenceItemType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY], CONSTRAINT [CONST_Reference_Item_Type_Name] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [Name] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY] TEXTIMAGE_ON [PRIMARY]
END
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ReferenceItem')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ReferenceItem]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ReferenceItemTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [Code] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [Visible] [bit] NOT NULL, [DisplayValue] AS ([utility].[GetObjectDisplayValueWrapper]('ReferenceItem',[ID],[ReferenceItemTypeID])), [SourceID] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [KeyHash] [varchar](50) NULL, [FieldHash] [varchar](50) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ReferenceItem] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY]
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ReferenceItem] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_ReferenceItem_Visible] DEFAULT ((1)) FOR [Visible]
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ReferenceItem] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_ReferenceItem_ReferenceItemType] FOREIGN KEY([ReferenceItemTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[ReferenceItemType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ReferenceItem] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_ReferenceItem_ReferenceItemType] END
